name: io.github.muad-yasin/the-high-council
title: The High Council
description: Several models from different labs plan in a blind proposal, debate and review loop. Your own keys.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Anthropic API key. Needed only by chains that seat Anthropic models.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own OpenAI API key. Needed only by chains that seat OpenAI models.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Google (Gemini) API key. Needed only by chains that seat Google (Gemini) models.

environmentVariables.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Mistral API key. Needed only by chains that seat Mistral models.

environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own DeepSeek API key. Needed only by chains that seat DeepSeek models.

environmentVariables.name: GROQ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Groq API key. Needed only by chains that seat Groq models.

environmentVariables.name: TOGETHER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Together API key. Needed only by chains that seat Together models.

environmentVariables.name: COHERE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Cohere API key. Needed only by chains that seat Cohere models.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own OpenRouter API key. Needed only by chains that seat OpenRouter models.

environmentVariables.name: ZAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Z.ai API key. Needed only by chains that seat Z.ai models.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_USD_PER_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Per-run spend ceiling in US dollars. The run stops before any stage that could pass it. Default 7.

environmentVariables.name: COUNCIL_WORKDIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for task files and run output. Default: the directory the client starts the server in.
